notes.batchSize: Companies researched per daily run. 8/day = full 200-company cycle every 25 days.
notes.reviewQueueCap: Max new listings queued for human review per day, priority-ordered (visa Yes first, explicit no-sponsorship last). Overflow stays in runs/<date>/checked-findings.json.
notes.stalePostingDays: Postings older than this without a stated deadline get a staleness warning from the Checker.
notes.workingBranch: All Joy Agent activity lives on this branch. The site only deploys from main, so daily runs never touch the live blog.
